decisions.point: Verdict or REVIEW for high escape-hatch density?
decisions.chose: Ordinary corrective verdict with a new Action.REPLACE_ESCAPE_TYPE.
decisions.rationale: The remedy is non-disjunctive — replace escape-hatch annotations with specific types — unlike call-islands (split OR intentional facade). So it does not warrant REVIEW. No existing Action fit (REPLACE_WITH_DOMAIN_TERM is a lexical/naming corrective), so the ontology gains one member. Purely additive, no behaviour change to existing findings.
rejected: Use Action.REVIEW: wrong — REVIEW is for disjunctive/judgment-dependent remedies; escape-hatch replacement has a single clear direction.
Reuse REPLACE_WITH_DOMAIN_TERM: it is a lexical naming action, not a type-annotation corrective.

decisions.point: How to support the min_annotations noise floor when the view returns only a density float?
decisions.chose: Add escape_hatch_counts() returning (escapes, total); keep escape_hatch_density() delegating to it.
decisions.rationale: The bare density discards the annotation count the floor gates on (a one-annotation module reads as 100%). A test pins escape_hatch_density()==0.5, so the float method stays; the counts method is additive. The rule derives density and applies the floor from the counts.
rejected: Change escape_hatch_density() to return a record: breaks the measure test (==0.5) and the existing smoke-test caller for no benefit.
Drop the noise floor: false-fires on thinly-annotated modules.

decisions.rationale: Fits the existing structure.* family (alongside structure.call-islands), hyphenated leaf per the convention. Avoids inventing a types.* family for a single rule (consumer-driven: create the family when >=2 type-discipline rules justify it). Revisitable if sentinels/hidden_mutators later cohere into a types family.
rejected: types.escape-hatches: more semantically precise but invents a one-member family prematurely.

Action enum extension is additive only — no existing finding's disposition/severity/action changes; the Verdict invariants in __post_init__ are unaffected (REPLACE_ESCAPE_TYPE is a corrective, not in DEFERRED_ACTIONS).

architectural_claims: Post-complexity rule ports are not purely mechanical: they surface small additive gaps in the view surface (scalar methods that discard counts a rule's noise floor needs) and the Action ontology (correctives not yet enumerated). The contract absorbs these additively.
The Action enum is extended per-rule as correctives are required; escape-hatch replacement is a non-disjunctive corrective verdict (not REVIEW).
behavioral_changes: Adds a default-enabled WARNING verdict rule structure.escape-hatches at the Module altitude (fires when >30% of a module's >=5 type annotations are escape-hatch types).
